main_key_review.en: The saved copy is gone too.

main_key_review.reading: Read as the second half of the card's status: 'Đã di chuyển hoặc bị xóa' then 'Bản sao đã lưu cũng không còn.' - the original is gone and the retained copy is gone as well.
main_key_review.assessment: Sensible and in voice. 'cũng' carries English 'too' with the same anaphora, and 'không còn' is the verb the neighbouring line already uses ('Tệp không còn ở đường dẫn này.'), so the two lines read as one verdict family. 'Bản sao đã lưu' is the exact term the file already uses for the retained copy (saved_copy_label, copy_saved_path, saved_path_copied), so terminology is consistent. Sentence case, one short sentence, full stop, no '!', NFC - all per the vi style guide. The sibling locales render the same shape (fr 'La copie conservée a aussi disparu.', zh-CN '保存的副本也已不存在。', ru 'Сохранённой копии тоже нет.'), so the voice agrees across the wave it came from.
